name: V oskolkakh vidneyetsya schastye
source:
...Life always goes on, despite any hardships. No matter how bad or how painful it gets, you always get up and keep moving forward. And when you can't, you remember Him and your own daughter. Your heart fills with warmth and affection, and you realize that you have something to live for. After all, even after death, life will always go on...

[Translated from [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3065995539]Steam[/url]]
